question: By what agency are all the mothers and yogeśvarīs drawn in their great power?
premises: The triad functions as an active drawing agency.
All mothers are included among those drawn.
The yogeśvarīs are included and possess great power.
inference: The triad draws all the mothers and the greatly powerful yogeśvarīs.
uncertainties: The specific identity of the triad is not explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: By the triad, all the mothers and the greatly powerful yogeśvarīs are drawn.
